verified_facts.text: Le Meurice is at 228 rue de Rivoli, opposite the Tuileries Garden and a five-minute walk from the Louvre.

verified_facts.text: From the hotel entrance you see the Louvre to the left and the Eiffel Tower to the right.
verified_facts.excerpt: From its entrance, you'll see the Louvre to your left, just five minutes' walk away, and the Eiffel Tower to your right.

verified_facts.text: Le Meurice has been known as the hotel of artists and free spirits since 1835.

verified_facts.text: Pablo Picasso hosted his wedding banquet at Le Meurice.

verified_facts.text: Bar 228 has live jazz every night.
verified_facts.excerpt: This is where Parisians settle down into deep leather armchairs and discreet conversation, enraptured by our nightly live jazz.
